summary.en: Regeneron's pipeline spans antibodies, bispecifics and genetic medicines across immunology, oncology and cardiometabolic disease. Its discovery platform is complemented by Alnylam licenses and Intellia collaboration; several major programs remain in Phase 3.
summary.zh: Regeneron的管线涵盖免疫、肿瘤和心血管代谢疾病领域的抗体、双特异性抗体和基因药物。其发现平台由Alnylam授权和Intellia合作补充；若干重大项目仍处于III期。

ind.en: Generalized myasthenia gravis; also PNH and geographic atrophy with/without pozelimab
ind.zh: 全身型重症肌无力；另有PNH和地图样萎缩（联合或不联合pozelimab）

ind.en: Adjuvant melanoma with cemiplimab; also metastatic melanoma
ind.zh: 联合cemiplimab辅助治疗黑色素瘤；另有转移性黑色素瘤

ind.en: Post-knee-replacement VTE prevention; also other thrombosis settings
ind.zh: 膝关节置换术后VTE预防；另有其他血栓场景

next.en: Initiate an additional Phase 3 anticoagulation study
next.zh: 启动另一项III期抗凝研究

ind.en: Stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation; also PAD and catheter thrombosis
ind.zh: 心房颤动卒中预防；另有PAD和导管血栓

ind.en: ATTR cardiomyopathy; also hereditary ATTR polyneuropathy
ind.zh: ATTR心肌病;另有遗传性ATTR多发性神经病

next.en: Phase 3 initiation in obesity without diabetes planned
next.zh: 计划启动无糖尿病肥胖患者的III期

ind.zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎

ind.en: Low-grade serous ovarian cancer; also high-grade disease and NSCLC
ind.zh: 低级别浆液性卵巢癌；另有高级别疾病和NSCLC
体位性心动过速综合征

next.en: Report Phase 2 POTS results; Phase 3 planned for H1 2027 subject to regulatory feedback
next.zh: 报告II期POTS结果；视监管反馈，III期计划于2027年上半年启动

watch.en: Sanofi collaboration revenue was $2.724 billion of Q3 total revenue of $5.116 billion.
watch.zh: 赛诺菲合作收入为27.24亿美元，占第三季度总收入51.16亿美元。

watch.en: Fianlimab's first-line metastatic melanoma trial missed its primary endpoint; adjuvant Phase 3 continues.
watch.zh: Fianlimab一线转移性黑色素瘤试验未达到主要终点；辅助治疗III期继续进行。

watch.en: The expanded Sanofi alliance adds long-acting immunology antibodies, with a $1 billion upfront payment and shared future economics.
watch.zh: 扩大后的赛诺菲联盟新增长效免疫抗体，首付款10亿美元，并分享未来收益。

watch.en: Cemdisiran's U.S. action date is in November 2026; EU decision is expected in H2 2027.
watch.zh: Cemdisiran的美国行动日期为2026年11月；预计欧盟决定在2027年下半年作出。

watch.en: The FDA lifted the clinical holds on nex-z's Phase 3 ATTR studies.
watch.zh: FDA已解除nex-z III期ATTR研究的临床搁置。

sources: Q3 2026 Form 10-Q: clinical stages and next milestones
gaps: Counts is null: the landing page reports about 50 molecules and 13 Phase 3 programs but no complete numerical Phase 1/2/registration series; an October corporate deck states 12 Phase 3 programs. These snapshots were not combined into invented counts.
Origins were not verified for fianlimab, cenvacibart, amrecibart, REGN1908-1909, ubamatamab and baloncibart. General platform statements were not taken as proof of each asset's internal origin.

The pipeline HTML omits numerical phase labels in extraction; phases use the quarterly filing and corporate deck. Olatorepatide and ALN-CIDEB remain phase 2 until their planned phase 3 starts are confirmed.
Cemdisiran monotherapy and pozelimab combination indications are consolidated to avoid repeating cemdisiran as separate assets. Pozelimab is already approved in another disease.
Future milestone dates remain unverified for amrecibart, REGN1908-1909, nex-z and ubamatamab. Cenvacibart's next stated company milestone is an additional Phase 3 start in Q4 2026.

Nex-z is gene editing, mapped to other because gene editing is absent from the required modality vocabulary. Olatorepatide follows the landing page modality group other; its more specific molecular format was not established from readable company material.
Approved linvoseltamab, garetosmab, DB-OTO and existing Dupixent/Libtayo uses were excluded, along with regional-only filings and dosing/formulation-only applications.

The filing and pipeline show spelling/extraction variants for certain generic names; item names follow the current pipeline spelling (notably baloncibart). No separate development code for cemdisiran or generic name for ALN-CIDEB was verified.
